report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services
observations_summary: The audit found significant human resource shortages (e.g., 21% overall staff deficit, 30-38% in specialists/paramedics) and underutilization of funds (e.g., 57.79% unutilized for RMNCH+A, 510.71 crore unspent under NHM). There were delays up to six years in hospital project completion, with 7 out of 8 new hospital projects experiencing time overruns and one having a significant cost overrun. Essential drug lists were not updated, and procurement failures led to hospitals buying drugs directly. Infrastructure development was slow, and regulatory bodies were ineffective.
